chunks: Moses said to him: 'May I follow you, on condition that you teach me from what you have been taught of the right way?'
ai.seo_question: What did Moses ask Khidr regarding his knowledge?
ai.summary: In this verse, Prophet Moses (peace be upon him) approaches Khidr, a servant endowed with special divine knowledge (‘ilm al-ladunni), to learn the deeper realities behind seemingly contradictory actions. This encounter underscores the Shia scholarly distinction between the exoteric law (zahir) followed by prophets and the esoteric wisdom (batin) revealed to specific servants, highlighting the necessity of humility even in prophetic figures when seeking divine insight.
